transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, I guess I'm here because... mostly I just don't feel like myself anymore. I've stopped doing pretty much everything I used to do. I used to go hiking, do some coaching, play my guitar... but I stopped all of that. I don't even call people back now. 

It's gotten to where some days I just sit in my small rental for hours. I sit there knowing there are things I need to get done, but... I just can't make myself start.
Can you tell me more about how you've been feeling emotionally lately? Specifically, have you noticed feeling down or hopeless most days?

No, I wouldn't say I feel down or hopeless. It's not like a sadness... I don't feel like crying or anything like that. I just, um... I don't really feel much of anything at all lately. It's more of a blank feeling than feeling depressed.
Have you noticed that you don't enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you've lost interest in activities you once found pleasurable?

I'm not really sure. I haven't really noticed if I enjoy things less. Like I was saying, I just stopped doing them. It's not that I tried playing my guitar and didn't like it... I just haven't picked it up at all. So I don't really know if the enjoyment is actually gone or not, because I just haven't been doing those things to find out.
Have you noticed that you don’t feel pleasure or interest in things you used to enjoy, even when you do them?

Well, like I was just saying... I haven't actually tried. I haven't done any of those things in a long time, so I can't really tell you if I'd enjoy them or not if I actually did them. I just haven't forced myself to try, so... I don't really have an answer for that. I just don't do them.
When you do happen to engage in activities, even routine ones, do you find that you don't feel pleasure or interest in them?

I really couldn't say. Even with routine stuff, like eating or... or watching TV, I just do it. I don't really think about whether I'm enjoying it or not. It's just something that happens. So, no, I haven't noticed feeling pleasure, but I haven't noticed not feeling it either. It's just... neutral, I guess.
Do you find yourself feeling down, low, or depressed most days?

No, not really. I don't feel sad or... depressed. It's kind of like what I was just saying a minute ago. I don't feel down, I just don't feel much of anything. I'm not sitting around crying or feeling low most days. It's just neutral. I just kind of exist.
When was the last time you genuinely felt pleasure or interest in anything you did, even small things?

I honestly can't remember. It's... it's been a really long time. Years, maybe. I just can't pinpoint a specific time where I felt that spark or, you know, actually cared about what I was doing. It's all just been a blur of... nothing, for as long as I can recall.
How long have you been feeling this way, with a lack of interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy?

I'd say... things have really been unraveling since I moved into the smaller rental after my divorce. That was about a year and two months ago. That's when it all just kind of settled into this, and nothing has really mattered much since then.
